thread:
ashley: Quick sync — we need to finalize the design partner recruitment priority and success metrics for the micro-beta cohort. Goal: 8-12 partners, 6-week engagement, mix of hosted + private evals. Thoughts on tradeoffs?

devon: Agree on target. Main constraint is Dedicated capacity for private evals — ops says ~3 concurrent private runs max. That affects invite cadence.

oliver: If we cap private runs to 3 at a time we should stagger start windows. Proposal: 3 private + 5 hosted in week1, then rotate in week3. Keeps feedback flowing.

kim: Staggering sounds good. Also let's be explicit about success metrics: 1) integration completion within 2 weeks, 2) 95th perc token latency under 350ms for hosted paths, 3) qualitative NPS >= 7 at week6, 4) 3 actionable issues per partner on average.

ashley: Nice. Can we make the integration completion metric flexible for larger infra teams? Maybe "integration start within 2 weeks" + a checkpoint at week4 for readiness.

devon: SG. Change to: "integration kickoff within 2 weeks" + "readiness checkpoint at week4". Ops: kim, do we need to reserve extra Dedicated slots for checkpoint smoke tests?

kim: Yes — reserve 1 spare private slot per week for checkpoints and troubleshooting. Ops cost impact is small but important.

oliver: On recruitment: prioritize customers with production intent + short onboarding windows. Suggested selector: 50% existing high-usage hosted customers, 30% platform partners (on-prem/priv), 20% new signups.

ashley: I want diversity across verticals too — marketing, search, internal tools, and regulated (1 partner). Add that to the selector.

devon: Incentives? We offered credits + priority support. Recommend adding a short implementation grant (handful of eng hours from solutions) for 3 partners to de-risk rollout.

kim: Solutions can support 3 grants. We'll track hours in the intake sheet. Also recommend a simple monthly cadence: 30m sync + 1 async feedback form every 2 weeks.

ashley: Logging/telemetry expectations: partners must enable request/response traces and anonymized logs for 6 weeks. We'll provide a telemetry guide. Any privacy blockers?

oliver: For regulated partner we need a signed DPA + on-prem checklist. Legal already flagged one partner candidate; coordinate before invite.

ashley: Good call. Nora-bot, drop the intake template link and the telemetry guide into the thread.

nora-bot: Links: 1) https://redwood.internal/docs/dp-intake-template 2) https://redwood.internal/docs/telemetry-best-practices

kim: On measuring quality regressions — let's add 10 deterministic prompts per partner to run each week and surface output diffs automatically. If regression rate > 5% we open an "eval incident" and roll to fallback model.

devon: That ties nicely to rollouts. We'll also tag model/quantization profile used per run to track perf vs quality.

ashley: Action items: 1) ashley: finalize selector & vertical targets (due EOD tomorrow) 2) devon: capacity plan + rotate schedule (due Tue) 3) kim: confirm solutions grants + reserve ops slots (due Tue) 4) oliver: prepare intake email template and legal check for regulated partner (due Fri) 5) nora-bot: attach templates (done).

kim: :thumbsup:

oliver: Fine by me. small ask — add a short "stop criteria" section: if fewer than 50% partners complete integration by week3 we pause new invites.

ashley: Add that. I'll update the doc and ping the recruitment thread. Thanks everyone.

devon: Happy to help with onboarding scripts when needed.

ashley: Great — closing this thread, will post the final invite list tomorrow. :rocket:
